column1: # This file REPLACES the old compiled-in jni/pool.hpp. The `sandboxid` CLI
# parses it at `freshen`/`seed` time and picks one persona matched to the
# device's real SDK level (same selection logic as before). Shipping it as
# data (instead of a C++ header) means personas can be refreshed WITHOUT a
# native rebuild -- autopif.sh upserts fresh Google builds into it.
# Format: 10 TAB-separated columns, one persona per line. Lines starting
# with '#' and blank lines are ignored. `platform` MUST stay within
# {gs101, gs201, zuma, zumapro, laguna} so the modem/RADIO + ro.board.platform
